name: ChipGroup
purpose: Shows a small set of related chips side by side — categories, tags or applied filters — as one labelled group.
neverUseFor: A single chip — use Chip alone instead
Choices the user turns on and off — use CheckboxGroup, RadioGroup or SegmentedControl instead
Values picked from a list — use MultiSelect instead

authored.name: disabled
authored.description: The whole group is non-interactive: every chip disabled.
authored.aria: disabled (native HTML attribute) on every chip

anatomy.description: Root — role="group" named by `label` (aria-label), and the wrapping row of chips itself: just the chips side by side, 4px apart in both directions (.ai/maps/patterns/group-spacing.md). No visible header or description — each option renders a real `Chip`.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name of the group (aria-label on role="group"). Never rendered visibly — the chips stand on their own.

props.name: options
props.description: The chips. Each option: { value, label, icon?, disabled? } — `value` is the React key.

props.name: size
props.description: Size of every chip in the group — Chip's own size scale.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every chip in the group.

height.note: Inherited unchanged from Chip's own size scale (Chip's local density model, not the ADR-004 control ladder).

width.note: The row wraps onto more lines when it runs out of width; rows sit 4px apart, same as the chips.

a11y.role: group (role="group" + aria-label holding the chips' own buttons)
keyboardNav: Tab - moves focus between chips and into/out of the group

properties.name: state
properties.description: Figma-only axis. The group itself has no hover/press/focus — those belong to each Chip instance (swap the instance's own state). disabled is the `disabled` prop.
